sections.heading: What is SEO ROI?
paragraphs: SEO ROI (Return on Investment) measures how much revenue SEO activities generate for a business compared to their cost. It helps tie your SEO efforts directly to business goals and proves the value of organic search.
A positive SEO ROI means the revenue generated by your SEO strategy exceeds its cost. Unlike paid ads, SEO compounds over time. Traffic gains persist even after the initial investment.

sections.heading: How to Calculate SEO ROI
sections.formula: SEO ROI = (Revenue from SEO - Cost of SEO) / Cost of SEO × 100

sections.heading: SEO ROI Timeline
paragraphs: Unlike paid ads that stop when you stop paying, SEO provides compounding returns over time with ongoing optimization.

bullets.label: Months 1-6
bullets.text: Foundation building, typically negative or break-even ROI

bullets.label: Months 6-12
bullets.text: Positive ROI typically achieved, traffic compounds

bullets.label: Year 2-3
bullets.text: Peak ROI as content matures and domain authority grows
